question.text:
White phosphorous $P_{4}$ has the following
characteristics

solution.text: WHite phosphorus $\left(P_{4}\right)$ has $6 P-P$ single bonds, 4 lone pairs of electrons and $P-P-P$ angle of $60^{\circ} .$ It is a translucent white waxy solid. It has large atomic size and less electronegativity. So, it forms single bond instead of $p \pi$ - $p \pi$ multiple bond. It consists of discrete tetrahedral $P_{4}$ molecule as shown in the figure.
